title: After settling the reeve/priest quarrel over the barrow doors (declined the reeve's promise, took the priest's blessing, chose 'open' at the throne), reporting back to the reeve produced only a flat acknowledgement line with no reputation or relationship consequence I could detect, despite him explicitly wanting the opposite outcome — the quarrel's setup implied more lasting weight than it paid off.
where: Last Light Square — talk to reeve, 'ask about the doors, left open'
